STYLE OF CAUSE: R. v. Chen
CITATION: 2022 SCC 14
COURT: Supreme Court of Canada
DOCKET: 39456
DATE: 2022-05-06

I. OVERVIEW
[1] This appeal concerns the proper interpretation of the reasonable expectation of privacy under section 8 of the Charter.
[2] The appellant was arrested following a warrantless search of his backpack at a public transit station.

II. ANALYSIS
[3] The Crown bears the burden of establishing that a warrantless search was reasonable in the circumstances.
[4] On the facts found by the trial judge, the search was not reasonable and the evidence obtained should have been excluded.
[5] The appeal is allowed, the conviction is set aside, and an acquittal is entered.
